title: Rabies prevention and control linked to livelihood transformation:
desc: Controlling the disease at its source through supporting businesses involved in dog and cat slaughtering and trading to transition to alternative livelihoods is proving to be a humane and sustainable approach in the capital city. The initial results from Hanoi's pilot model using the "One Health" approach have become valuable practical experience for the Dong Nai city delegation to visit and learn from, gradually realizing the national goal of eliminating rabies deaths by 2030.
